description: List the workspace's posts, newest first; each says who made it (made_by: person or agent) and, for a Reel with a Trial Reel, its pair. Filter by target state, e.g. awaiting_approval for the approval queue or failed for problems, by hook (how a post opens), or made_by=agent for the drafts an assistant made. state=draft also lists video projects, which have no accounts yet.

hook.description: Only posts tagged with this hook type (see post_hook_set)

limit.description: How many posts, newest first, e.g. 25

made_by.description: agent: the drafts an assistant or API connection made; person: the ones made in the app. Every post says which in made_by

state.description: Only posts in this state, e.g. draft, scheduled or published

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: post_list
title: List posts
